title: RoBERT2VecTM: A Novel Approach for Topic Extraction in Islamic Studies
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2024
problem: Arabic morphology and the dominance of English-centred tools make topic modelling of Classical Arabic religious texts difficult.
architecture: Contextualized Topic Model with hybrid document embeddings combining an Arabic-fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa with Doc2Vec (200-d); domain stopword list and lemmatisation; CTM with one 128-neuron ReLU layer and Adam; topics manually merged into Islamic domains.

datasets.name: Hadith
datasets.details: more than 14,940 Ahadith from Sahih Al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim

key_results: With lemmatisation and stopword removal (50 topics): CV 0.61, TD 0.53, NPMI 0.060 vs BERTopic 0.55, 0.51, 0.053.
Without lemmatisation CV drops to 0.53, showing the effect of Arabic preprocessing.
strengths: Applies contextual topic models to Classical Arabic with careful preprocessing analysis.

limitations.text: Only one dataset and one language; may not generalise to other non-Latin languages.
Absolute NPMI values are low for all models (at most 0.060).
